description: This file defines the ConceptDatatype class, which models concept data types within the OpenMRS API. It includes constants for HL7 abbreviations and UUIDs, properties for datatype ID and HL7 abbreviation, and utility methods to determine the type of data (e.g., numeric, coded, date, time, boolean).

classes.name: ConceptDatatype
classes.description: Represents a data type for concepts in the OpenMRS system, including properties and helper methods to identify datatype types.

methods.name: getConceptDatatypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the ConceptDatatype.

methods.name: setConceptDatatypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID for the ConceptDatatype.

methods.name: getHl7Abbreviation
methods.description: Returns the HL7 abbreviation associated with this datatype.

methods.name: setHl7Abbreviation
methods.description: Sets the HL7 abbreviation for this datatype.

methods.name: isAnswerOnly
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is answer-only, indicated by a specific UUID.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is numeric based on UUID.

methods.name: isCoded
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is coded (from vocabulary).

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Checks if the datatype represents a date.

methods.name: isTime
methods.description: Checks if the datatype represents a time.

methods.name: isDateTime
methods.description: Checks if the datatype represents a date-time.

methods.name: containsDate
methods.description: Checks if the datatype contains date information.

methods.name: containsTime
methods.description: Checks if the datatype contains time information.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is of text type.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is boolean.

methods.name: isComplex
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is complex.

methods.name: isRule
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is a rule.
